definitions.explanation: Lacking care, precision, or attention to detail. Describes work, actions, or a manner that is done without sufficient effort or thoroughness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雑|ざつ}だ。
{雑|ざつ}な⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れる→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: If you handle it roughly, it'll break.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{雑|ざつ}で、⟦{細|こま}かい→細かい：01245_komakai⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にしない→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧だ。
examples.english: He has a rough personality and is the type who doesn't worry about the small details.

notes:
A very common colloquial na-adjective expressing a lack of care or precision. It has a mildly negative tone but is often used in a frank, everyday way rather than as harsh criticism. Can describe physical actions (rough handling), work quality (sloppy output), personality (not detail-oriented), or even speech and explanations (vague, careless).

The adverbial form {雑|ざつ}に is also frequently used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {雑|ざつ}な⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: sloppy work
- {雑|ざつ}な⟦{扱|あつか}い→扱い：12777_atsukai⟧: rough handling
- {雑|ざつ}な⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: careless explanation
- {雑|ざつ}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: rough-and-ready personality
- {雑|ざつ}に⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to put down carelessly

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦いい{加減|かげん}→いい加減：09353_iikagen⟧な: irresponsible; half-hearted — stronger criticism, implies lack of sincerity
- ⟦{大雑把|おおざっぱ}→大雑把：06867_oozappa⟧な: rough; broad-brush — less negative, can be neutral ("big-picture oriented")
- ⟦{粗|あら}い→粗い：00439_arai⟧: coarse; rough — more about texture or physical roughness than carelessness
- ⟦{適当|てきとう}→適当：01674_tekitou⟧な: slapdash; half-hearted (colloquial) — similar casualness but also means "appropriate" in formal use
